posts.summary: October 11, 2026, the world observes the International Day of the Girl Child under the urgent and powerful theme: “End child marriage and invest in girls’ rights!&rd...
posts.content:
October 11, 2026, the world observes the International Day of the Girl Child under the urgent and powerful theme: “End child marriage and invest in girls’ rights!” 
The day serves to champion their empowerment and celebrate the boundless potential that blooms when a girl’s rights are protected and her ambitions nurtured. 
At just five years old, Maia Oiseoghade, a student at Victory Academy of Learning, is a vibrant, local embodiment of this year’s theme.
